name: Crispian Morris
tagline: Computer Science PhD student at the University of Bristol, applying machine learning to image and video processing.
bio: I'm a PhD student with a 1st class degree in Engineering Mathematics and over two years of experience in industry. Highly organised, I manage my time autonomously while remaining an integral part of any team. I'm interested in developing computer technologies, quick to adapt to new approaches, and naturally creative when solving problems. My research interests sit at the intersection of computer vision and artificial intelligence.

education.description: BBC/iCASE funded PhD looking at deep learning inspired computer vision approaches for object detection in low-light videography.
1st Class Honours, with a focus on data science, artificial intelligence and machine learning.

work.title: Laptop and Mobile Clinic Supervisor
work.description: I worked with, and intermittently supervised, a team of technicians helping University students troubleshoot issues on their personal devices. We handled a variety of cases, from resolving incorrect network configuration to advising students about digital best practice. I was awarded the Outstanding PLUS award in the 'Everyday Hero' category for my efforts.

work.title: Engineering Assistant
work.description: I assisted the engineers at KVAL with intermediate CAD, organised several file servers, and significantly increased their overall productivity. I completed research projects on potential applications of new technologies in the industry, and helped manage the GitHub repositories associated with our production flows.

publications.title: PocketDVDNet: Realtime Video Denoising For Real Camera Noise
publications.venue: ICASSP 2026 - 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP)
publications.description: A lightweight video denoiser built with sparsity-guided pruning, a physics-informed noise model and knowledge distillation: 74% smaller, with better denoising quality, and fast enough for real-time use.

publications.title: Towards a General-Purpose Zero-Shot Synthetic Low-Light Image and Video Pipeline
publications.venue: Proceedings of the 3rd International Workshop on Multimedia Content Generation and Evaluation (in conjunction with ACM Multimedia)
publications.description: A zero-shot pipeline for synthesising realistic low-light images and video, for training and evaluating methods without paired real-world data.

publications.title: DaBiT: Depth and Blur Informed Transformer for Video Deblurring
publications.alias: Also listed as Video Focal Deblurring
publications.venue: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV / WACVW)
publications.description: A transformer that uses depth and blur estimates to remove accidental out-of-focus blur from video, with a new benchmark for the task.

publications.title: ST-MFNet Mini: Knowledge distillation-driven frame interpolation
publications.venue: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP)
publications.description: Pruning and teacher-student distillation shrink ST-MFNet by 91% in parameters and run 35% faster, while staying close to far heavier interpolation models.
